faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DRRMLIMS Medical Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the DRRMLIMS Medical Officer position is 01-10-2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree and hold a valid registration from the respective state Medical Council or the National Medical Commission (NMC) to be eligible for this post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Medical Officer position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Medical Officer post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 72,000.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Medical Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Medical Officer position is between a minimum of 21 years and a maximum of 62 years.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the DRRMLIMS Medical Officer vacancy?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it to the official address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Medical Officer role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of applications, followed by an interview and document verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this Medical Officer position?
faq.answer: The position of Medical Officer is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the Dr. Ram Manohar Lohia Institute of Medical Sciences located?
faq.answer: Dr. Ram Manohar Lohia Institute of Medical Sciences is located in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, with the pincode 226010.
